points.name: Beaver Dams — Boreal Forest Lake
points.note: Multiple beaver dams here — the best cementing paste spot on the map.

points.name: Beaver Dams — West
points.note: Beaver dams / cementing paste spot on the western side of the map.

points.name: Blue Obelisk
points.note: Blue Obelisk terminal — boss tributes and item/dino uploads.

points.name: Green Obelisk
points.note: Green Obelisk terminal. The Forsaken Oasis boss fight (Dragon + Manticore) is entered from an obelisk terminal — tribute guides point to this one, and ASE guides confirm any obelisk terminal or supply beacon works, so there is no separate on-map boss terminal.

points.name: Red Obelisk
points.note: Red Obelisk terminal — boss tributes and item/dino uploads.

points.name: Spider Cave (The Lair) — Entrance
points.note: Artifacts of the Strong, Immune and Pack. Spider-infested; a strong cave tame helps (Megatherium shines). Obsidian inside.

points.name: The Lost Temple — Entrance
points.note: Artifacts of the Brute and Devourer. Press the button to open the temple door; metal inside. Hard — grappling hooks help.

points.name: The Unknown (Aberration Trench) — Main Entrance
points.note: Sinkhole entrance by the lake. Artifact of the Gatekeeper inside. Radiation zones — full hazard suit required; no flyers allowed in the trench.

points.name: The Unknown (Aberration Trench) — Waterfall Entrance
points.note: Entrance hidden in a waterfall on the east side. Artifact of the Gatekeeper. Radiation — hazard suit; no flyers.

points.name: Cave of the Gatekeeper — Entrance
points.note: One of several entrances into the Gatekeeper cave system in the Aberration trench. Rich metal inside. Radiation — hazard suit.

points.name: Cave of the Gatekeeper — Entrance
points.note: One of several entrances into the Gatekeeper cave system in the Aberration trench. Rich metal inside. Radiation — hazard suit.

points.name: Cave of the Gatekeeper — Entrance
points.note: One of several entrances into the Gatekeeper cave system in the Aberration trench. Rich metal inside. Radiation — hazard suit.

points.name: Cave of the Gatekeeper — Entrance
points.note: One of several entrances into the Gatekeeper cave system in the Aberration trench. Rich metal inside. Radiation — hazard suit.

points.name: Wyvern Trench (The Great Trench) — Entrance
points.note: Fire wyvern nests and a lava cave at the far end; on ASE the Artifact of the Skylord is in the trench. Sulfur, obsidian and metal inside. Extreme heat and wyverns.

points.name: Ice Cave — Entrance
points.note: Artifacts of the Cunning and the Destroyer. Extreme cold — fur armor and cold-resistant tames; dire bears, wolves and yetis inside.

points.name: Boreal Forest Cave (Crag Cave) — Entrance
points.note: Artifact of the Crag. Lava cave in the mountain — approach past the rectangular ruin near 31.8 / 51.9. Three loot crates inside.

points.name: Waterfall Cave (Cave Within a Cave) — Entrance
points.note: Entrance hidden behind a waterfall. Dive pools inside connect to an underground cave network spanning much of the map.

points.name: Red Obelisk Cave — Entrance
points.note: Cave near the Red Obelisk in the south-west (guide-listed entrance).

points.name: Western Cave — Entrance
points.note: Cave on the west coast (guide-listed entrance).

points.name: Under Castle Cave — Entrance
points.note: Cave beneath the castle on the east coast (guide-listed entrance).

points.name: Narrow Cave Network — Entrance
points.note: Narrow cave network in the east (guide-listed entrance).

points.name: White Cliffs Cave — Entrance
points.note: Tiny, hard-to-find opening near this point leading into a long cave.

points.name: The Abyss — Entrance
points.note: Dive entrance to The Abyss, the underground ocean. No air pockets — bring scuba gear or a water tame. Deep-sea loot crates, black pearls and oil inside.

points.name: The Abyss — Entrance
points.note: Dive entrance to The Abyss, the underground ocean. No air pockets — bring scuba gear or a water tame. Deep-sea loot crates, black pearls and oil inside.

points.name: Bottom of the Lost Temple stairs
Fire Wyvern Nests — Wyvern Trench
points.note: Nests line the underground lava trench; steal fertilized fire wyvern eggs. Extreme heat, many wyverns.

points.name: Ice Wyvern Nests — Wyvern Scar (Surface)
points.note: The old wyvern's den: ice wyvern nests with blue eggs along the cliff face of the valley. Lots of ice wyverns.

points.name: Deinonychus Nest — White Cliffs
points.note: Deinonychus nest that may hold a fertilized egg; packs guard their nests fiercely.

points.name: Deinonychus Nests — White Cliffs
points.note: Nest cluster — up to 7 nests reported in this immediate area.

points.name: Deinonychus Nesting Area — Southern White Cliffs
points.note: Deinonychus spawn and nesting area near the raw salt flats; eggs on the cliffs and on the ground.

points.name: Deinonychus Nests — Broken Bridge
points.note: 4–5 nests reported here, plus 3 more underneath the broken bridge (player-reported).
